name: trader-skill-india
description: 17 Claude skills for Indian stocks and F&O: copy a mutual fund or investor from SEBI disclosures, watch NSE/BSE filings and insider trades, screen futures and options with stop-loss, targets and trailing stops backtested on real data, replay every way a trade can end with the odds of each (the Time Machine), size every trade in whole shares or lots with real charges, check SEBI and exchange rules, and never place an order without your yes.
